rows.threshold: Relative soil moisture <= 75.0 % for 10.0 consecutive days
rows.qualitative_impact: Sustained soil-moisture deficit can constrain reproductive development and seasonal rice performance.

details.limitations: The operational soil-moisture definition must be matched before transfer.

rows.threshold: Daily mean temperature <= 20.0 °C for 1.0 consecutive day
rows.qualitative_impact: Cold exposure around booting or flowering can impair reproductive development and seed set.

details.limitations: Relaxed duration and regional scope; not globally validated.

rows.threshold: Daily total precipitation >= 25.0 mm/día for 1.0 consecutive day
rows.qualitative_impact: Heavy rainfall can disrupt panicle emergence or flowering and, during filling, reduce radiation and increase lodging or disease pressure.

details.limitations: Based on a local Chengdu standard; rainfall is an exposure indicator, not a universal damage threshold.
